title: Starch Extractor
keywords: Consumes recipe-defined nutrient and furnace fuel to produce FE over the fuel’s burn time

blocks.text: Consumes recipe-defined nutrient and furnace fuel to produce FE over the fuel’s burn time.

rows: Put valid furnace fuel in the first input.
Put an accepted starch-value ingredient in the second input.
Accumulate enough nutrient for a fuel start, then export FE.

blocks.text: Fuel alone is insufficient if the nutrient reservoir is below its configured start cost.
